title: Old Town Scottsdale Lux Villa, Pool, Rooftop Views
description: Book your own private resort with The 1 Home: the epitome of Scottsdale luxury and style. This 10,000-square-foot three-story mansion is located near Scottsdale's finest shopping, dining, and nightlife. Entertain your guests on the sprawling rooftop deck or sip wine while watching the sunset over Camelback Mountain. Enjoy endless amenities: heated pool and spa, gym, chef's kitchen, private underground speakeasy and movie theater, spa with sauna, soaking tub, and steam room, and so much more.
amenities: Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
